faqs.a:
Chapter 80 Referenced Standards,
is hereby amended by addition of the following section and subsection:
Section 8001
Adoption of Standards
"Section 8001.1
NFPA Standards. In every case where this code references a standard published by
                  the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), the most current edition of the referenced
                  standard is hereby adopted. The most current edition of the referenced NFPA standard
                  shall become effective on January 1
st
following publication and release of the standard."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
